behaviourVerified: Default opt-in disabled; only exact true enables it
Source absent/incomplete does not consume an acquisition claim
Execution retains its first durable poll across task retry/hour boundaries
At most two discovery attempts per poll, no repeated work from duplicate launches
Selected cycle is pinned between discovery and acquisition
Product guard and per-cycle create-only claim prevent duplicate acquisition
Validated durable checkpoint resumes before another source probe and without a second acquisition
No takeover of unresolved acquisition solely because time passed
Unknown legacy claims and corrupt/invalid data fail closed
Readback is required before a publication is called complete
FVG current coverage uses icon2i_48h_v1; national retains its existing twelve-hourly-sample coverage policy
limitations: Offline simulation and source/configuration review only; no real-cloud execution, deployment or published-data validation of this new implementation
Cost is unmeasured. No-GRIB polls still perform Storage reads; FVG may revalidate all current municipality payloads multiple times per invocation
National verified bundles are reused only for the same manifest within one invocation; cache is cleared after publication for fresh final readback
Legacy migration and rollback require quiescent executions and state review; mixed old/new producers are not approved
An abandoned acquisition without a complete authenticated checkpoint remains unresolved/manual review; national crash before complete manifest is not automatically reacquired
Each window requires at least the same-day 00Z or 12Z cycle; an intermediate advanced but earlier cycle remains excluded, and after +4 hours recovery awaits the next window
Pending and in_progress produce non-successful task outcomes; existing failure-policy impact must be reviewed before activation
Task retries and exceptional platform redelivery can add launches beyond the 16 scheduled starts; durable tickets bound useful work rather than all platform costs
No Web/Android build, browser/device test or pilot 5174 launch from this worktree was performed; canonical pilot remains a separate running workspace
Source hashes identify the uncommitted candidate, not a released immutable artifact
